name: nyxscope
description: Multi-protocol SDR receiver for Windows. Bundles the best open-source decoders behind one UI: P25 (Phase 1+2),   DMR/NXDN/EDACS digital voice, ADS-B/AIS/ACARS/VDL2 tracking, HD Radio, POCSAG/FLEX paging, 200+ rtl_433 ISM   sensors, LoRa. Up to 16 concurrent VFOs, live spectrum & waterfall, per-channel recording and transcription. No sidecar setup
